title: A Disk-based Dynamical Mass Estimate for the Young Binary AK Sco
question: What is the dynamical mass of the AK Sco binary from its circumbinary disk CO rotation curve, and how does it compare with RV constraints and pre-MS evolutionary model predictions?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 45 uJy/beam; CO rms 4 mJy/beam per 0.4 km/s channel

what.value: UBVRI photometry compilation used for SED

evidence.quote: The $UBVRI$ photometry compilation of (cite: jensen97) was used to construct the AK Sco SED.

what.value: RV constraint M sin^3 i = 2.114+/-0.010 Msun, period, mass ratio, eccentricity
Distance estimates used for prior (144+/-12 pc; 141+/-7 pc)

evidence.quote: Recently, (cite: anthonioz15) combined astrometric and radial velocity monitoring to estimate $d = 141\pm7$ pc.

what.value: Teff = 6450+/-150 K prior from F5 classification

evidence.quote: which we associate with $T_{\rm eff} = 6450\pm150$ K

recipe.method: CASA calibration, phase-only self-cal, 30 s averaging, continuum subtraction, natural-weighted CLEAN; CO averaged to 0.4 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Forward-model CO visibilities with disk model
recipe.method: Parametric disk structure with LTE RADMC-3D ray tracing at 2.5 AU pixels, FFT and interpolation onto observed uv points, chi^2 likelihood
key_parameters: 12 free parameters: T10, q, Mco, rc, xi, M*, i_d, phi, offsets, vsys, d; gamma fixed to 1
assumptions: LTE level populations; Keplerian rotation dominated by binary mass; vertical hydrostatic equilibrium; vertically isothermal

recipe.goal: Compare with RV and astrometric constraints
recipe.method: Convert RV M sin^3 i using disk inclination assuming co-planarity; derive dynamical distance from M/d and M sin^3 i

recipe.goal: SED fit and pre-MS model mass and age
recipe.method: BT-Settl SED model with extinction and per-band jitter, MCMC; then map Teff, L posterior onto four evolutionary grids
key_parameters: Teff prior 6450+/-150 K; d prior 142+/-6 pc
assumptions: identical binary components; solar metallicity; Fitzpatrick reddening with R_V=4.3; near-IR excluded

evidence.quote: we derive a dynamical distance to the system of $d=145.5 \pm 2.0$ pc
a total flux density of $32.65\pm0.07$ mJy
has an integrated intensity of $2.21\pm0.01$ Jy km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Number, initialization and length of MCMC chains, burn-in length, and Gelman-Rubin values
Outer disk radius, inner radius, and CO abundance/photodissociation treatment in the disk model
Which channels were treated as line-free for continuum subtraction
Phase center coordinates and the target coordinates
Number of CLEAN iterations, mask and threshold
Exact SED priors on the nuisance jitter terms and logg
Details of the evolutionary grid inputs
missing_for_reproduction: MCMC chain settings and priors bounds
Jitter priors and evolutionary grid details
score_reason: Single public dataset, open code and clearly specified model; some MCMC and imaging settings are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, open code, numeric headline result (M*=2.49 Msun).
